name: Jamin
overview: The name Jamin appears in Scripture primarily as a son of Simeon, establishing a family line among the tribes of Israel, as noted in Genesis 46:10, Exodus 6:15, and Numbers 26:12 where the Jaminites are identified as a distinct family group. Additionally, Jamin is mentioned in Nehemiah 8:7 as a Levite priest who played a vital role in teaching and explaining the Law to the returning exiles in Jerusalem, highlighting a faithful commitment to God's word and covenant during the restoration period.
